sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx:Quality Checks!A24:D24 and Internal Quality Checks!A24:F24 (plus complete Quality and Deterministic sheets)
evidence: The frozen workbook Quality Checks!A24:D24 requires every test.sh launch assumption, including injected env vars and paths, to be public. tests/test.sh:97-109 selects /app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db according to write access, then starts node with env -i and DB_PATH=$APP_DB; the restart helper repeats DB_PATH at lines 160-166. The public instruction.md:3-5 delegates runtime details to six notes. integration.md:3-5 correctly states /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000, /, GET /api/health, Node 22, Express, better-sqlite3 and NODE_PATH; integration.md:7-9 states /assets/seed_data.json, durable shared records and the symlink limit. Across instruction.md and all six notes, DB_PATH is never named; policy.md:3 instead leaves the database schema to the builder. The frozen template integration.md:6-7 explicitly said to honor DB_PATH. The golden's solution/app/server.js:8 happens to honor it, which does not repair the agent-facing omission. test.sh has no same-origin demand; public network is authorized. The raw-evidence-index.json named by the assignment was absent when checked, and this read-only review did not run the full verifier, so no runtime or portal result is claimed. Files independently hashed: frozen test.sh SHA256 BD68259276CA4B034654EFC8A1723A4E702ED62DBE590AF6201565F43EABE5AA; integration.md SHA256 30278C6930A0B2F92162BE7BFFA4A1C5774B7FDAEC9C2D792B837DF6ECBB13C5; workbook SHA256 6D44970B2FF67FEFAD1E2327E743FC226FCD4C50FF55BAF899F41069A9B3FD7F.
counterexample: A builder can satisfy the public notes with a file-backed shared library at /app/workspace.json and an otherwise working Node server, never reading DB_PATH. If /app is not writable to the unprivileged process, test.sh:99-109 launches the copied server from /tmp/submission and points DB_PATH there; the conforming app still tries /app/workspace.json and cannot save, causing a verifier failure tied to an undisclosed launch rule. In the other direction, a broken server that answers / and /api/health but ignores persistence passes this script's launch preflight; subsequent browser scoring may reject it, so this is not claimed as an overall task pass.
suggested_fix: Add to the agent-facing integration note that the launcher sets DB_PATH to a writable persistent file for the run (normally /app/app.db, or the copied app path if needed), and require the app to honor it for saved state; state that PORT is 3000 as an environment variable if intended as an app contract. Keep the shared test.sh and scoring policy unchanged.
